text:
Elaine: Heads-up - noticed follow-ups from last week’s outage are drifting. Proposal: adopt a '72h fast-followup' timeline + lightweight ownership tracker. Sketch below, feedback?
Chris: Can you sketch the timeline? are we talking reminders or actual gating of closure?
Elaine: Timeline idea (draft):
```txt
- T0 (incident closed): owner assigned in postmortem doc (24h)
- T+24h: owner confirms scope + initial next steps
- T+72h: fast follow-up — short status + risks + ETA
- T+7d: 1-week review, assign if any long-running remediations
- T+30d: quality check for recurrence signals
``` 
Chris: Nice. I like the 72h probe — catches things early. +1 to owner SLA
Maya: Suggest we add an automated Slack reminder and a GitHub issue template that mirrors those checkpoints. Also add a 'recurrence pattern' checkbox so we can tag PMs if needed.
Jamal: Operational note: owners need clear SLAs and a way to escalate if they can't make the 72h milestone. Propose 'backup owner' field and a weekly remediation sync for blocked items.
Sophie: For tracking, can we centralize in a single Google Sheet or use the existing remediation board in Jira? Single source of truth is key. 
Nikhil: IC rotation thought — let's make IC handoff explicit in the postmortem meta: IC on call (current week), next IC (named), and a short handover note. Rotation cadence: 2 weeks seems to balance continuity vs burnout.
Elaine: Agreed. I'll draft a compact IC handoff checklist:
```txt
- Current IC: short incident timeline + why fallback chosen
- Owner list + backups
- Open remediation tickets with short status
- Any recurring signal patterns observed
- Immediate next steps for 72h follow-up
``` 
Maya: Can the deploy-bot create the 72h reminder and ping the owner and #eng-oncall automatically?
deploy-bot: Reminder rule created: will post to #eng-oncall at T+72h and add a DM to the assigned owner. Links to postmortem doc will be included. :white_check_mark:
Chris: A couple process asks:
- Make the owner field required in postmortem template
- Add 'recurrence' tag that triggers monthly signal analysis
- Start a weekly 30-min remediation sync (voluntary) to unblock owners
Elaine: I'll update the postmortem template, add required owner + backup + 'recurrence-flag'. I'll also create a short playbook page for the IC handoff and 72h fast-followup. 
Jamal: Can we pilot this on 1-week incidents first? lower risk to iterate.
Sophie: +1. Also please add a one-line summary field so PMs can triage if an incident recurs for customers.
Elaine: Plan: I'll push template updates today, create the deploy-bot rule, and schedule a 4-week pilot. Volunteers for the pilot IC rotation?
Chris: I can be IC week 1 of pilot.
Maya: Week 2.
Nikhil: Week 3.
Sophie: Happy to help with tracking and the remediation board.
Elaine: Great - I'll post the pilot plan in #eng-oncall tomorrow and link the draft template. Thanks all :thumbsup:
